content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

The choice of an attending physician is at the discretion of the patient. Yet the funds of the health insurance companies are a common benefit for all premium payers. They should not be spent on personal preferences without proven use. The effectiveness of many natural remedies has not been demonstrated. Therefore no unproven and unrecognized treatments by naturopaths should be reimbursed by the insurance companies.
What argument components exists in sentence " They should not be spent on personal preferences without proven use" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>They should not be spent on personal preferences without proven use</pro>
